selected_evidence.requirement: Routed WireGuard tunnel using wg01 on both gateways
selected_evidence.summary: Both wg01 interfaces have current handshakes and traffic counters; remote-LAN routes select wg01, and tunnel addresses communicate bidirectionally without loss.

selected_evidence.requirement: Serve node3 application on TCP/8080 and allow node4 access
selected_evidence.summary: The node3 service is active, enabled, and listening on 10.10.10.10:8080. Node4 routes through its LAN gateway and receives the application response.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep routed traffic free of address translation
selected_evidence.summary: The application observes node4's original 10.20.20.10 address, while both VyOS gateways report that NAT is not configured.

selected_evidence.requirement: Limit new cross-LAN connections to the application path
selected_evidence.summary: TCP/22 listeners existed on both hosts, but new cross-LAN TCP/22 attempts timed out in both directions. Firewall counters recorded the denied SYNs and the permitted TCP/8080 connection.

#!/usr/bin/python3
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        body = f"lan-a application\nclient={self.client_address[0]}\n".encode()
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        print(f"{self.client_address[0]} {fmt % args}", flush=True)

ThreadingHTTPServer(("10.10.10.10", 8080), Handler).serve_forever()
ANTRIEB_APP
